about_the_game:
Game Description:

Welcome to the enchanting world of Finding Pots & Pets Demo! Dive into the magical realm of Bunnyland and experience a taste of our charming hidden object adventure. This demo features the first level and a glimpse of the second, offering a perfect introduction to the game's delightful pixel art environments and relaxing gameplay.

In this demo, you'll explore the beginner-friendly first level, designed to ease you into the world of Bunnyland. With its smaller map size and fewer objects, it's the perfect starting point for your journey. As you progress, you'll get a sneak peek at the second level, showcasing the increasing complexity and charm that awaits in the full game.

Key Features:

  • Experience 1.2 levels out of the full game's 9 unique environments

  • Explore the beginner-friendly first level, featuring a smaller map and fewer objects for an easy start

  • Discover a portion of the second level, hinting at the increased challenge and variety to come

  • Enjoy beautiful pixel art landscapes filled with cute animals and exquisite pots

  • Relax with soothing background music and gentle sound effects

  • Test your observation skills as you search for hidden pets and pots Get a taste of the game's intuitive hint system

  • Meet a few of the quirky NPCs that populate Bunnyland

Dive into Finding Pots & Pets: Demo Edition and let the hunt begin! Can you uncover all the secrets this slice of Bunnyland has to offer? Start your whimsical journey today and discover the joy of finding the cutest pets and most beautiful pots in this pixelated paradise.
